items.t: Tsawwassen Springs is the largest condo group, on Springs Boulevard by the golf course, with buildings at 5055 and 5099 Springs Boulevard, by Shato Holdings and Talisman Homes.
Market Commons, 6322 Market Avenue in Southlands, lists 66 one- to three-bedroom freehold strata condo flats across from Market Square.
Southlands condo flats are freehold strata, not leasehold, per Century Group's Southlands FAQ.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Condos: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Town-centre condos sit in the SD1-A Tsawwassen Neighbourhood Centre and Corridors development permit area for form and character.
56 Street proposals use the Neighbourhood Centre and Corridors (NC) designation in Official Community Plan Bylaw No. 8400, 2024.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Condos: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Beach Grove Park, 6051 17A Avenue, serving Beach Grove strata streets, lists off-leash areas, tennis courts and trails.
Winskill Aquatic and Fitness Centre is being replaced (started summer 2025) with a ten-lane, 25-metre lap pool.
Diefenbaker Park, 5579 1 Avenue, a former gravel operation, lists a viewpoint, trails and water park.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Condos: development and new projects

items.t: KinVillage Phase 2, 1050 54A Street, applicant Ankenman Associate Architects: 143 seniors affordable rental apartments, six storeys. Status: rezoning application, feedback closed December 17, 2025 (as of November 3, 2026).
Malcolm Centre, 1505 56 Street, applicant BURO47 Architecture: 45 rental apartments over 4 retail units, six storeys. Status: rezoning application, meeting April 9, 2026 (as of November 3, 2026).
1219 Hunter Road, applicant BURO47 Architecture: 68 market apartments, six storeys, replacing a 2022 40-unit approval. Status: not yet to Council (as of November 3, 2026).

Bus route 620 links Bridgeport Station (Canada Line) directly to the Tsawwassen ferry terminal. BC Ferries' own directions tell foot passengers to take the Canada Line to Bridgeport, then the 620 bus to the terminal.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Condos: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check a Beach Grove condo's flood protection on DeltaMap: it carries flood protection, dike elevations and permit areas by parcel.
Oceanfront rules can affect Beach Grove buildings: the City lists the Fisheries Act, Water Sustainability Act, Riparian Areas Regulation and flood requirements as possibly applying.

Century Group's Southlands FAQ states every Southlands home is freehold, never leasehold, and that condo flats at Market Commons and the other Southlands buildings are freehold strata homes whose monthly fee covers common-area maintenance, landscaping and snow removal.

faq.q: Where are the new rental apartments in Tsawwassen?
faq.a: Clara Apartments, at 1467 56 Street, is a purpose-built rental building under construction near Tsawwassen Town Centre. Its site lists 48 homes — studios, one- and two-bedrooms — with completion and first move-ins stated as Spring 2027. The City also notes periodic single-lane closures on 56 Street, between 9 a.m. and 3 p.m., during that construction work.

faq.q: Which schools serve a 56 Street condo?
faq.a: South Delta Secondary is the public secondary school for Tsawwassen addresses. Delta School District No. 37 publishes Tsawwassen-area catchment maps and notes boundaries are reviewed and occasionally adjusted, so verify a building's exact address in the district School Locator before enrolment.

faq.q: Is a home on Tsawwassen First Nation lands taxed like a Delta condo?
faq.a: No — treaty lands are outside the Speculation and Vacancy Tax areas.
